author: Peggy Vargas
text: As a new homeowner, I wanted to take care of replacing my older gas water heater right away. Alexis's Finest Plumbers was recommended to me by another contractor in Omaha. Earl came out to inspect the job and give me an estimate, and I was very impressed with how clearly he explained everything and answered my questions about the water heater and plumbing connections. The scheduling process was smooth and professional, and on installation day Earl and John arrived on time as promised. They removed the old water heater and installed the new one carefully and efficiently. They were very respectful of my home, covering the floors and keeping the work area clean during the whole removal and installation process. The workmanship was excellent, with great attention to detail, and everything was completed the right way. While they were there, they also replaced the old washing machine supply lines with braided stainless-steel lines at my request, which gave me extra peace of mind. I’m very happy with the service and would give Earl and John the highest rating for their plumbing work.

author: Virginia M
text: I’d highly recommend Alexis's Finest Plumbers. They were clear about the plumbing work that needed to be done, gave me a few good options, and provided upfront pricing from the start. John and Avery were friendly, professional, and very knowledgeable. They installed a brand-new garbage disposal under my kitchen sink, even though there had not been one there before, and they finished the job within a couple of hours on the same day as the estimate. They also tested everything, explained how the new unit worked, and made sure the area was completely cleaned up before they left. I had put off this plumbing upgrade for a long time, but after making one call to schedule, the whole process moved quickly and smoothly, and now I finally have the garbage disposal I had been wanting.

author: Krista Marshall
text: Top notch plumbing service, fair pricing, and quality work. As a first-time homeowner, I ran into major water backup and flooding issues just days after buying the house, so I needed a plumber I could trust right away. I got in touch with Earl and felt confident from the start. The crew was easy to talk with, friendly, respectful, and clearly knew sewer line work inside and out. They replaced my sewer line within 48 hours, and the whole job was handled smoothly and professionally. Even after the excavation and repair, my gravel driveway looked great and you could hardly tell that major plumbing work had been done. They kept me updated through each step, explained what was happening in simple terms, and gave me helpful advice on how to keep the sewer line in good shape and help extend its life. For a messy drain and sewer job, they ran a very clean operation and paid attention to details from start to finish. I really appreciated being included in the process and never felt left in the dark. If you need a plumber in Omaha for sewer line repair, drainage problems, or flooding issues, this team offers reasonable prices, excellent workmanship, and treats customers with real respect while keeping the experience as stress-free as possible.

author: Tricia Lucas
text: after calling around to several plumbers, we hired a local plumbing company to install a flood control system for our basement in omaha. we chose a double valve flood control setup with precast concrete rings instead of a block-built pit, and the plumber clearly explained both options so we could make the right choice for our home. after dealing with basement water issues, we wanted a reliable plumbing solution and a fair price. this company gave us a straightforward fixed quote, which made the whole process much easier than other plumbing estimates we received. avery took time to inspect the home, answer our questions, and make sure no other drain or sewer line work was needed before starting. the installation was completed in one day, and the crew worked efficiently, kept the area organized, and handled the job professionally from start to finish. the work passed inspection without any problems, which gave us extra confidence in the quality of the plumbing installation. communication throughout the project was excellent. avery and john were easy to reach, kept us updated, and made the entire experience smooth and stress-free. we are very pleased with the flood control work and would gladly hire them again for plumbing, drain, or sewer services in omaha.

author: Logan Hicks
text: After buying my house, I found a leaking gas line that had not been disclosed. I wanted a plumbing company that would properly inspect the line, explain the repair clearly, and give me a fair estimate. After a bad first quote from another plumber, I decided to get a second opinion. John came out, checked the gas piping carefully, took proper measurements, and explained what needed to be repaired in a simple and professional way. He was respectful, prompt, and clearly knew his plumbing work. We had a small delay with email communication at first, but everything was handled well and the scheduling was completed without much trouble. The estimate was much more reasonable than the first one, and the value for the gas line repair was excellent. On the scheduled day, the crew arrived on time, worked quickly and efficiently, and completed the job with great attention to detail. They also cleaned up thoroughly after the repair and even swept the area, which I really appreciated. Overall, this was a very good experience. The plumbing team was honest, skilled, and easy to work with, and I would definitely call them again for any future plumbing or gas line issues.
